Location and access – Pullman Maldives Maamutaa Resort – 5-star resort
Virtual tour
Pullman Maldives Maamutaa - Luxury hotel - LOCATION
Welcome to our unparalleled location
Pullman Maldives is located on a private island called Maamutaa, with 18 hectares of lush vegetation and a rich marine life full of colorful species. The island is reached via a 55-minute wheel-based flight from the capital, Malé, to Kooddoo Airport – priced at USD 700 per adult (12 years and above), USD 500 per child (2 years until 11.99 years), and complimentary for infants (below 2 years, sitting on parents lap) for a roundtrip.
Guests can also reach the island through a private seaplane transfer, priced at USD 19,000 per way.
As your journey will continue via a 15-minute speedboat ride, get ready to enjoy awe-inspiring views of the Indian Ocean.
Once you arrive at our resort, you will be welcomed by our Pullman team who will guide you through the check-in process and once finalized, our Island Hosts will give you a guided island tour on the way to your villa.
We hope you enjoy our beautiful island, relax and have a wonderful stay!

The Aqua Villa
The Aqua Villa
Discover the The Aqua Villa experience by Pullman, an immersive encounter with marine life from the comfort of your bed that will nurture your childhood curiosities and bring them to life. Enjoy the serenity of the Indian Ocean and find the perfect balance of both play and rejuvenation.
Because Pullman is a great believer of balancing work and play, and that s why at Pullman Maldives there is so much more than just sitting back, sleeping and taking a selfie.
This luxury two-level Aqua Villa has a submerged master bedroom combined with an overwater bedroom and plenty of space for you to relax and live your once in a lifetime story.
The Aqua Villa Experience is your childhood curiosities come to life. It’s play, but not as you know it. It’s moments you want to share with the world. And more importantly, with those closest to you.
Imagine the serenity of diving, without a tank. Or sharing midnight secrets, in an aquarium that’s uniquely yours. You can’t possibly? At Pullman we thrive on the impossible.
But that s not all!
At Pullman Maldives we are proud to be the first luxury resort to have 2 underwater bedrooms in Maldives.
Let s dive into the details
VIEW VILLA FACT SHEET
UNDERWATER BEDROOM
With one submerged bedroom beneath the turquoise waters, be prepared to discover the magic of the ocean whilst enjoying the stylish comfort that we have to offer. The Aqua Villas are a rarity in the Maldives and at Pullman we are proud to be a leader in immersive travel for this destination.
The Aqua Villa experience by Pullman is a way to wake up to the beauty of swaying corals. To colorful schools of fish. To yourself in a way you never thought possible. This is a place a myriad of marine life call home. And now it can be your home, too.
OVERWATER BEDROOM
Not only is there an aquarium as a bedroom which provides an open view of the underwater life, but there is also a second bedroom looking out across the ocean the moment you walk upstairs.
Because for Pullman comfort always comes first. And at Pullman Maldives, style is never without substance. Complete with all the amenities of an Ocean Villa and a large swimming pool with a private deck area, the Aqua Villa experience is as submerged as you make it.
With an exclusive pool location facing East, it s the perfect spot to relax in the early hours with a private sunrise yoga session or simply cool off with a dip.
The Aqua Villas are in a prime position to watch the sunrise and are only a short walk away from Sol Rising the  sunrise bar serving healthy breakfast and fresh juices.
Drink in hand, gaze at the sunset, contemplate the fish, forget the world outside and chill out at your deck or living room with unique views of the Indian Ocean.
Book a night. Or three. Or five. And be one of the few people in the world to have a favourite underwater bedroom.
Opening your eyes to a unique emotional connection with marine life might just be more accessible than you think.

Villa amenities
• 209 m2 / 1,216 ft
• Minibar replenished once daily
• Indoor & outdoor showers
• Island bathtub
• Nespresso coffee machine
• Lounge in balcony
• Selection of tea and snacks
• Life vests
• Direct access to the lagoon
• Sun loungers

Four Bedroom Ocean Pool Retreat
Four Bedroom Ocean Pool Retreat
If life is all work and no play, it s time to get away! the Four Bedroom Ocean Pool Retreat is a sprawling overwater villa outfitted with modern high-tech amenities and luxe accommodations for the perfect fun-filled, sundrenched gathering with family and friends.
VIEW VILLA FACT SHEET
THE CONCEPT
Within 1,474 square meters (4,835 square feet), The Four Bedroom Ocean Pool Retreat’s living and dining areas open up to the spacious sundeck with direct access to the ocean for snorkeling right off the villa. A Jacuzzi and outdoor shower flank one of the largest private overwater infinity pools in the Maldives.
At Pullman, fun means peak performance and wellness too: the villa comes with its own private gym, a Spa Room for in-villa treatments, and a steam room. Entertainment is abundant, care of large screen Smart TVs and a game room with a billiard table.
While staying at the Four Bedroom Ocean Retreat, guests are also treat to Pullman Maldives generous all-inclusive benefits which include unlimited dining and drinks at the resort s three restaurants and three bars, a twice-daily replenished mini-bar with premium alcohol, and a slew of activities and excursions, from adventurous watersports to centering yoga classes.
Designed with the world s New Entrepreneurs in mind, the Four Bedroom Ocean Pool Retreat is the ultimate island playground with everything needed for living your best life to the fullest in one of the most sought-after locations in the Maldives.
